title: 第两千六百六十三章古问天第两千六百六十二章祖之道
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: 敖楚歌战败！
九玄祖域的生灵呆愣在原地，还处在失神的状态中。
他们到现在也不敢相信来自禁忌之地的敖楚歌会战败。
他可是至高圣龙族的传人，血脉都已返祖到了极致，拥有了先天龙体，可他竟然败在了另一条龙的手中。
按照常理，这一战面对低等黑龙，应是他的碾压局才对，凭借血脉返祖的绝对优势，同境几乎没有龙族会是他的对手。
结果事实却是反过来了。
出身低等黑龙族的天命无极以绝对的实力压制了本该占据优势的敖楚歌！
这一战，无论放在哪个时代，都没有人能看懂。
来自低等黑龙族的龙竟击败了血脉返祖的圣龙！
匪夷所思！
“楚歌败得不冤。”开天抱着膀子说道。
天命无极果然如混沌道君说的一样，不是一般的黑龙，其底蕴无比雄厚，就算是他同境遇上天命无极，恐怕也无法轻易镇压对方。
“废物！”曲澜蹙眉。
开天将纳兰凌霄抓了回来，结果敖楚歌又被抓走，这不等于白忙活一场？
“你说什么？”
朱蝉衣不悦看来。
她也来自禁忌之地，自然听不得自己那方天地的顶级怪物被侮辱。
她看得出来这一战敖楚歌输得不冤，走出‘祖龙’之道的天命无极对于其他龙族强者来说，完全可以算是另一个次元的怪物，能赢才奇怪。
想要与天命无极为敌，只能是其他族群的同层次强者，亦或是同样走出‘祖龙之道’的龙族怪物。
“我说的有错？他是至高圣龙族，却输给了一条低等黑龙，我骂他废物已是在夸他。”曲澜丝毫不怵，冷脸直言。
“别吵架。”开天巨大的身躯横在两人中间，乐呵呵的笑道：“输就输了，咱们后面再找回场子不就行了？”
“哼！”朱蝉衣和曲澜轻哼一声不再说话。
“开天说得对，不过输一场，我们还不至于输不起。”
一位坐在后方闭目养神的男子睁开双眸看来，他的双眸中竟有明月升起，月光闪过，无比美丽。
男子名古问天，同样来自禁忌之地，修为是无上境五步。
“问天都说话了，二位还不给个面子？”开天说道。
“问天哥，楚歌已经战败，轮到你我时，可不能再败了。”朱蝉衣认真说道。
她极有自信，但敖楚歌这一败也给她提了醒，三十三天的怪物中也有非同小可的人物，虽然他们每个人都是极强的怪物，但也必须谨慎，这第二战无论如何都要拿下！
“来到这里不就为了赢吗？”古问天起身，气质儒雅随和，面带和煦笑容道：“楚歌的仇便由我们给他报。”
开天看着古问天，眼里有强烈的战意闪过。
古问天在禁忌之地的名气极大，如今已是古神族的少族长，未来必将引领古神族走向更辉煌的时代。
在开天剑宗时，开天便听长辈提起过古问天，说此人非同小可，两人若是交手，让他一定要小心。
这次见到古问天，开天便想和对方同境切磋一次，奈何古问天没什么兴趣，这人谦虚的很，待人随和，一点傲气不见。
“听闻三十三天也有古神族，这一族应该也有像样的强者吧？”韩诸说道。
“就怕修为不符合要求。”曲澜开口。
“这一族与你们那里的古神族有何区别？”说话之人银发披肩，眸光阴翳，面庞带着邪魅。
男子名妖月清，来自天妖族，准无上境后期修为。
“都是古神族，自然没有区别，只是生活在不同界域的族群而已。”古问天回应。
“你说的话你自己信吗？”妖月清冷笑一声，“你这副谦虚模样应该是装出来的吧？真正的你是什么样？”
“世人目光多有偏见。”古问天摇头一笑，并未因妖月清的怀疑生怒。
content_en:
Ao Chuge was defeated!
The creatures in the Jiuxuan Ancestral Domain were stunned on the spot, still in a state of confusion.
Even now, they still can't believe that Ao Chuge, who came from the Forbidden Land, would be defeated.
He was a descendant of the Supreme Holy Dragon Clan, and his bloodline had returned to the extreme, possessing an innate dragon body, but he was defeated by another dragon.
According to common sense, this battle should be his crushing match against the low-level black dragon. With the absolute advantage of his bloodline returning to his ancestors, almost no dragon clan in the same realm would be his opponent.
It turned out that the opposite was true.
Tianming Wuji, who was born in the low-level Black Dragon Clan, used his absolute strength to suppress Ao Chuge, who should have had the upper hand!
No matter what era it was in, no one could understand this battle.
The dragon from the low-level black dragon clan actually defeated the holy dragon whose bloodline had returned to his ancestors!
Unbelievable!
"Chu Ge was defeated unjustly." Kaitian said, holding his arms.
Tianming Wuji is indeed as Chaos Dao Lord said, it is not an ordinary black dragon, its foundation is extremely rich, even if he meets Tianming Wuji in the same situation, I am afraid he will not be able to suppress the opponent easily.
"Trash!" Qu Lan frowned.
Kaitian captured Nalan Lingxiao, but Ao Chuge was captured again. Doesn't this mean that all the work was in vain?
"What did you say?"
Zhu Chanyi looked unhappy.
She also came from a forbidden place, so naturally she couldn't bear to hear the top monster in her world being insulted.
She could see that Ao Chuge had not lost the battle unjustly. Tianming Wuji, who had followed the path of the 'ancestral dragon', could be regarded as a monster from another dimension to other strong dragons. It was strange that he could win.
Those who want to be enemies with Tianming Wuji can only be strong men of the same level from other ethnic groups, or dragon monsters who have also followed the 'Way of the Ancestral Dragon'.
"Is what I said wrong? He is from the Supreme Holy Dragon Clan, but he lost to a low-level black dragon. I called him a waste and I was praising him." Qu Lan was not afraid at all and said bluntly.
"Don't quarrel." Kaitian's huge body stood between the two of them and said with a cheerful smile: "If you lose, you lose. Can't we just find the situation later?"
"Humph!" Zhu Chanyi and Qu Lan snorted and stopped talking.
"Kaitian is right, but if we lose one game, we won't be able to afford to lose."
A man sitting in the back with his eyes closed and meditating opened his eyes and saw the bright moon rising in his eyes. The moonlight flashed through, which was extremely beautiful.
The man, named Gu Wentian, also came from a forbidden place, and his cultivation level was five steps to the supreme realm.
"Wentian has already spoken, why don't you two give me some face?" Kaitian said.
"Brother Wentian, Chu Ge has been defeated. When it's your turn and my turn, we can't lose again." Zhu Chanyi said seriously.
She was extremely confident, but Ao Chuge's defeat also reminded her that there are extraordinary characters among the monsters of the Thirty-Three Heavens. Although each of them is an extremely powerful monster, she must be cautious. This second battle must be won no matter what!
"Aren't you here just to win?" Gu Wentian stood up, with an elegant and easy-going temperament, and said with a warm smile: "We will avenge Chu Ge's revenge."
Kaitian looked at Gu Wentian, with a strong fighting spirit flashing in his eyes.
Gu Wentian is extremely famous in the forbidden land. He is now the young patriarch of the Ancient God Clan and will surely lead the Ancient God Clan to a more glorious era in the future.
When he was in Kaitian Sword Sect, Kaitian heard his elders mention Gu Wentian, saying that this person was not trivial, and he must be careful if the two of them fought against each other.
When he saw Gu Wentian this time, Kaitian wanted to have a discussion with him, but Gu Wentian was not interested. This man was very humble, easy-going, and showed no arrogance.
"I heard that there is also an Ancient God Clan in Thirty-Three Heavens. There should be decent strong men in this clan, right?" Han Zhu said.
"I'm just afraid that my cultivation level doesn't meet the requirements." Qu Lan said.
"What's the difference between this clan and your ancient god clan?" The speaker had silver hair shawl, dark eyes, and an evil look on his face.
The man's name is Yao Yueqing, who comes from the Heavenly Yao Clan and is in the late-stage cultivation of the Quasi-Supreme Realm.
"They are all ancient gods. There is no difference. They are just ethnic groups living in different realms." Gu Wentian responded.
"Do you believe what you say?" Yao Yueqing sneered, "You must be pretending to be so humble, right? What are you really like?"
"The world's eyes are biased." Gu Wentian shook his head and smiled, not angry at Yao Yueqing's suspicion.
